title: AIWG Storage Configuration v1
description: Configures AIWG storage adapters per subsystem. Lives at .aiwg/storage.config in a project. Absence is equivalent to all subsystems using the local filesystem under .aiwg/. See .aiwg/architecture/storage-design.md for the design rationale and #934 for the originating proposal.

version.description: Schema version. Consumers MUST refuse to load configs with a version they do not understand.

roots.description: Override the physical filesystem location of specific subtrees. Keys are subsystem identifiers; values are paths (relative to project root, or absolute, or starting with ~ for the user home). Has no effect on subsystems whose backends.<subsystem>.type is not 'fs'.

backends.description: Backend selection per subsystem. Each subsystem maps to exactly one backend configuration. Subsystems not listed default to backend type 'fs' (no override).

fallback.description: Behavior when an external backend is unreachable. Default 'cache_and_warn' queues writes under .aiwg/.storage-cache/ and continues; 'block' refuses the write.

$comment: Credential keys (token, password, secret, apiKey, accessKey, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey) are forbidden at every level — credentials must come from environment variables or the OS keychain. Validation enforces this in two ways: schema-level (forbidden property names below) and a runtime walk in aiwg doctor that scans every property name recursively.

noCredentials.description: Enforces that no credential-shaped property names appear at this level.

vault.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault directory.

folder.description: Optional subfolder inside the vault to scope AIWG writes (e.g., 'AIWG/memory'). Default: vault root.

useCli.description: Prefer the official Obsidian CLI (Feb 2026+) over direct file writes. Default true. When false, the adapter writes via fs.writeFile and warns the user that Obsidian must reload the vault.

graph.description: Absolute path to the Logseq graph directory (contains pages/, journals/, logseq/).

apiUrl.description: Logseq HTTP API base URL. Default http://127.0.0.1:12315/api when useApi is true.

useApi.description: Prefer the Logseq HTTP API over direct file writes. Default true. The API token is read from the LOGSEQ_API_TOKEN environment variable.

parent.description: Notion parent reference. Either a page (creates child pages under it) or a database (creates rows). Authentication token is read from NOTION_API_TOKEN env var.

externalIdProperty.description: Name of the page property used for upsert/dedup. Adapter computes external_id = sha256(subsystem + ':' + relative_path).

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the AnythingLLM instance, e.g., http://localhost:3001

folder.description: Optional folder name within the workspace. Default: subsystem name.

mcpServer.description: MCP server identifier registered in the AIWG MCP config. Adapter calls Fortemi's MCP tool surface (capture_knowledge, update_note, etc.).

scheme.description: Optional SKOS scheme to scope this subsystem's writes (e.g., 'aiwg-memory').

prefix.description: Object key prefix inside the bucket.

endpoint.description: Optional S3-compatible endpoint URL (for MinIO, Cloudflare R2, etc.). Credentials come from the AWS default credential chain — never from this config.

authMode.description: Auth scheme. Credentials are read from AIWG_WEBDAV_USER/AIWG_WEBDAV_PASSWORD or AIWG_WEBDAV_TOKEN env vars.
